protocol.role: development certificate-only fixed-state sidecar on consumed states

excluded_actions.reason: resident class has no arrivals in the three-class q01 protocol

registered_state_schema.population_visits: load, seed, source policy budget, frame count, and legacy visited time
registered_state_schema.legacy_k26: registered fixed action, score, certificate, work, and exact flag
registered_state_schema.support_reference_score: registered exhaustive legacy K120 support optimum

source_population_summaries.population_role: primary frozen K26 policy state distribution
primary frozen K26 policy state distribution
primary frozen K26 policy state distribution

rule.executed_action: copy the registered legacy K26 raw option tuple, service, duration, and score exactly
rule.raw_fifo_upper_bound: run the unchanged FIFO-execution quotient selector at paid budget K26 and use its returned upper bound only
rule.sidecar_upper_bound: minimum of the registered legacy K26 upper bound and the raw FIFO K26 upper bound
rule.fixed_action_gap: sidecar upper bound minus the fixed legacy K26 score; no clamp is applied
rule.fixed_action_epsilon: fixed-action gap divided by visible queue norm, or zero for the empty queue
rule.fixed_action_exact: fixed-action gap is at most the registered score tolerance and all upper-bound validity checks pass
rule.fifo_search_exact: reported separately from fixed-action exactness and never changes the fixed action
rule.unchanged: model, 5,003-state roster, K26 paid budget, feasibility, legacy raw tie break, loads, seeds, and population weights

timing_protocol.selector_order: legacy first on even state_index and FIFO first on odd state_index
timing_protocol.warmup: none; the timed calls are also the correctness reconstruction calls
timing_protocol.reported: legacy-only, incremental FIFO, and composite wall seconds and milliseconds per state, plus incremental and composite ratios over legacy
timing_protocol.interpretation: descriptive implementation-cost diagnostic only; no timing value changes a scientific decision

protocol.stopping_rule: invalid execution gives INVALID_EXECUTION; a valid pointwise-safe result with all nonworse gates and at least one strict primary certificate gain gives CERTIFICATE_TIGHTENING_ONLY_CLOSE; failure of any nonworse gate gives CERTIFICATE_TRADEOFF_STOP; an otherwise nonworse result without a strict gain gives NO_CERTIFICATE_GAIN_STOP. Every valid decision stops without trajectories.
protocol.prohibited_in_this_stage: changing the registered legacy K26 action or score, using the FIFO-selected action, arrival generation, trajectory simulation, new seeds, rule variants, runtime thresholds, confirmation outcomes, and paper edits

next_step: record the certificate tightening with unchanged trajectories and close this sidecar
limitations: The 5,003 queues and mechanism rationale are consumed development evidence.
The certificate concerns maximum one-frame support for the fixed legacy K26 action; it does not improve that action's support score.
Legacy visited-time weights are reused only to summarize exposure; the fixed action makes the corresponding trajectory exactly unchanged.
Wall timings are one interleaved diagnostic pass and have no scientific threshold.
